_comment: Project-name mappings. A group lists spellings that all mean THE SAME project.
'groups'     - used by BOTH matchers: the forgiving one (Red Flag row, Tracker row, approvals
sheet lookup, config lookups) and the strict one (Key Focus Area).
'strictOnly' - used by the STRICT matcher ONLY, i.e. Key Focus Area.
Why the split: the forgiving matcher joins a name to a group when it shares one word with any
member. Putting 'Madakuhosahalli' in a shared group with 'Nandi Hills [MH]' would therefore have
made it a 100% match for 'Nandi Hills [Sult]' and 'Nandi Hills [Ach]' as well, because those
share the words 'Nandi' and 'Hills'. The strict matcher requires EXACT membership, so the same
entry is safe there. Declare a new Key Focus mapping under 'strictOnly' unless the forgiving
Key Focus Area matching order: exact project code -> exact project name -> exact alias listed
here -> the record is EXCLUDED. There is no partial, keyword or fuzzy matching.
